name: mdrv_get_file
description: Get one file's metadata by `id` (UUID): name, content_type, size_bytes, starred, folder_id, trashed_at, created_at. Find the id via mdrv_list_folder / mdrv_list_starred / mdrv_list_trash. This returns metadata only — the raw bytes are served (to a browser session) at /api/v1/files/{id}/download.
